title: Thermo-mechanical post-treatment: A strategic approach to improve microstructure and mechanical properties of cold spray additively manufactured composites

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Anshan Group Aluminum Powder Co., Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Secondary_Powder_Source: De Er Peng Ye Technology Co., Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: Powders were mixed at room temperature with 5 mm ZrO2 balls in long roll jar mill rotated at 100 rpm for 2 h. After blending operation, ZrO2 balls were sieved out from the feedstock, feedstock was dried for 10 h in the oven at 80 °C

experimentalProperties.Tensile_Test_Orientation: Rolling direction (parallel to spray gun traverse)

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: composed of randomly dispersed B4C particles in the matrix formed by deformed Al splats

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Anshan Group Aluminum Powder Co., Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Secondary_Powder_Source: De Er Peng Ye Technology Co., Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: Powders were mixed at room temperature with 5 mm ZrO2 balls in long roll jar mill rotated at 100 rpm for 2 h. After blending operation, ZrO2 balls were sieved out from the feedstock, feedstock was dried for 10 h in the oven at 80 °C

experimentalProperties.Tensile_Test_Orientation: Rolling direction (parallel to spray gun traverse)
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: TMTs were performed in two steps, heating the samples at ~500 °C in the furnace for 2 h followed by (ii) unidirectional rolling at a rolling speed of, 0.03 m/s to achieve 20, 40 and 60% thickness reductions in 1, 2 and 3 passes, respectively,each rolling pass, samples were reheated to ~500 °C for 15 min. After rolling treatment, samples were allowed to cool down in the air. Rolling was performed in the direction parallel to the spray gun traverse direction

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: modified microstructure with redistribution of B4C particles in the matrix composed of slightly elongated Al splats
